source: Original (freshly authored 2026-10-05, AA SL 1.4, calculator allowed). $5000 at 4% compounded annually: 1.04 multiplier; 5000*1.04^6 = 6326.60; interest 1326.60; first exceeds $8000 after 12 years (11 years 7697.27, 12 years 8005.16).

parts.label: a
parts.description: Sofia invests $5000 at 4% per year compounded annually, FV = P(1 + r/(100k))^(kn). Write down the number that the value is multiplied by each year.
parts.notes: A1 for 1.04. A multiplier of 0.04 or 1.4 earns no mark.

parts.label: b
parts.description: Sofia invests $5000 at 4% per year compounded annually, FV = P(1 + r/(100k))^(kn). Find the value of the investment at the end of 6 years.
parts.tolerance: Accept any value that rounds to $6330 at 3 s.f., including $6327 and $6326.60. Accept the TVM solver (N = 6, I% = 4, PV = -5000, PMT = 0, P/Y = C/Y = 1).
parts.notes: M1 for 5000 multiplied by 1.04 raised to the power 6, however written. A1 for 6326.60 or an accepted rounding. An exponent of 5 ($6083.26) earns the M1 only. Simple-interest working (5000 + 6*200 = 6200) earns no marks.

parts.label: c
parts.description: Sofia invests $5000 at 4% per year compounded annually, FV = P(1 + r/(100k))^(kn). Find the total interest earned at the end of 6 years.
parts.notes: A1 for the value from (b) minus 5000.
parts.follow_through: Award A1 for the candidate's own value from (b) minus $5000.

parts.label: d
parts.description: Sofia invests $5000 at 4% per year compounded annually, FV = P(1 + r/(100k))^(kn). Find the number of complete years after which the value first exceeds $8000.
parts.tolerance: Accept solving 1.04^n > 1.6 on the GDC, with logarithms, or the TVM solver for N.
parts.notes: M1 for an inequality or equation 5000*1.04^n = 8000 (or >), a table search, or TVM set-up. A1 for 12. A table search with both adjacent years, or a single row at 12 years, earns full marks (markscheme-spec §18). 11.98 as the final answer, or rounding down to 11, earns the M1 only.

source: Original (freshly authored 2026-10-05, AA SL 1.4, calculator allowed), modelled on 25M.2.AHL.TZ2.4. $12 000 at 5.2% compounded monthly for 10 years = 20 161.67; real value with 2.8% inflation = 20 161.67/1.028^10 = 15 296.61 (real-rate method 2.4%: 15 251.33); real increase 3296.61; real value of $12 000 cash = 9104.37.

parts.label: a
parts.description: Daniel invests $12 000 at 5.2% per year compounded monthly. Inflation is 2.8% per year; the real value of $A after n years is A/(1 + i/100)^n. Find the value of the investment at the end of 10 years.
parts.tolerance: Accept any value that rounds to $20 200 at 3 s.f., including $20 162 and $20 161.67. Accept the TVM solver (N = 120, I% = 5.2, PV = -12000, PMT = 0, P/Y = C/Y = 12).
parts.notes: M1 for a monthly rate of 5.2/1200 and an exponent of 120. A1 for 20 161.67 or an accepted rounding. 5.2% compounded annually ($19 922.26) earns no marks.

parts.label: b
parts.description: Daniel invests $12 000 at 5.2% per year compounded monthly. Inflation is 2.8% per year; the real value of $A after n years is A/(1 + i/100)^n. Find the real value of the investment at the end of 10 years.
parts.tolerance: Accept any value that rounds to $15 300 at 3 s.f. (both the division method and the real-rate method, 5.2 - 2.8 = 2.4%, round to this).
parts.notes: M1 for dividing the (a) value by 1.028^10, or for compounding $12 000 at the real rate 2.4%. A1 for an accepted value. Multiplying by 1.028^10 ($26 574) or subtracting 2.8% once ($19 597) earns no marks.
parts.follow_through: Award M1A1 for the candidate's own value from (a) divided by 1.028^10.

parts.label: c
parts.description: Daniel invests $12 000 at 5.2% per year compounded monthly. Inflation is 2.8% per year; the real value of $A after n years is A/(1 + i/100)^n. Hence find the real increase in the value of the investment.
parts.tolerance: Accept $3300 or $3297; with the real-rate method accept $3250 or $3251.33.
parts.notes: A1 for the real value from (b) minus 12 000. 20 161.67 - 12 000 = 8161.67 earns no mark: that is the increase before inflation.
parts.follow_through: Award A1 for the candidate's own value from (b) minus $12 000.

parts.label: d
parts.description: Daniel invests $12 000 at 5.2% per year compounded monthly. Inflation is 2.8% per year; the real value of $A after n years is A/(1 + i/100)^n. Daniel's sister keeps $12 000 in cash for the same 10 years. Find the real value of her cash at the end of the 10 years.
parts.tolerance: Accept $9100 or $9104; with the real-rate method accept $9030 or $9033.25.
parts.notes: M1 for 12 000 divided by 1.028^10 (or multiplied by 0.972^10). A1 for an accepted value. '$12 000' earns no marks.
